prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1013; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you confirm you're okay with that?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Great. Can you describe what happened on the day of the collision?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in League City, waiting to turn left. I had been there for maybe thirty seconds when I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest.

Q: Which vehicle was behind you?

A: A pickup truck. The driver got out and came up to my window pretty quickly. He said he had looked down at his phone for a second and didn't brake in time.

Q: Did you exit your vehicle at the scene?

A: Yes, I got out to look at the bumper. There was a crack in the rear of my car and the pickup had some damage to its front end.

Q: Did you feel any pain right away?

A: Not right away. About an hour later my lower back started tightening up, and by the next morning it was hard to get out of bed.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon and was seen again by my primary doctor later in the week. They diagnosed a back strain and told me to rest, take anti-inflammatories, and do some gentle stretching.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Some days are better than others. Sitting for long periods bothers me, and I've had to skip a few shifts at work because of it.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm hoping to get back to normal soon.

Q: Thank you for your time. We'll be in touch with next steps.
